likasi-cd.reason: Old black-and-white archival photo (c.1930) of a single colonial-era building (church/mission with tower), not a modern city view of Likasi.

loudi.reason: Real color photo of a Loudi street intersection with buildings, traffic, and pedestrians — a genuine city view, not an isolated monument.

luan-cn.reason: Real photo of a river with apartment towers, but the original title indicates it was shot incidentally from a train window en route to Shanghai-Hongqiao, so it's not clearly or reliably a depiction of Lu'an itself.

lubsko.reason: Real photo of Lubsko's historic town square (town hall and church) with cars and surrounding buildings — represents the town center, not a single isolated landmark.

ludhiana-in.reason: Shows only a railway platform and station sign reading 'Ludhiana Jn' — confirms location but does not show the city at all.

luliang-cn.reason: Real wide aerial/elevated photo of Lüliang's skyline and urban sprawl — a genuine city view.

lusaka.reason: Real photo of downtown Lusaka with multiple skyscrapers (including the Samsung-branded tower), fountain, and skyline — clear city view.

lviv-ua.reason: Shows only Lviv University's main building and plaza — a single isolated landmark, not a city view.

luohe-cn.reason: Shows only the Luohe railway station building and forecourt (Chinese characters confirm location), not a view of the city.

maceio-br.reason: Real photo of Maceió's coastal avenue with traffic, palm trees, buildings, and turquoise ocean — a genuine city view.

madurai-in.reason: A multi-panel collage/montage of 7 separate images, not a single real photo.

maipu-cl.reason: A multi-panel collage/montage of 8 separate images, not a single real photo.

majuro-marshall-islands.reason: Old 1978 photo of a UN mission delegation boarding a plane on an airport tarmac — doesn't show the city of Majuro at all.

maianga-ao.reason: Real elevated photo showing a broad cityscape of Luanda/Maianga with a skyscraper under construction and dense urban area beyond — a genuine, if hazy, city view.

makhachkala-ru.reason: A multi-panel collage/montage of 6 separate images, not a single real photo.

maiduguri-ng.reason: Shows only the Maiduguri Central Mosque against the sky — an isolated monument, not a city view.

malegaon.reason: Shows only the ruins of Malegaon Fort — an isolated monument, not a city view.

managua-ni.reason: Real aerial dusk/night photo of Managua showing Avenida Bolívar, illuminated 'árboles de la vida' sculptures, the plaza, and surrounding city — a genuine city view.

manaus-br.reason: A multi-panel collage/montage of 6 separate images, not a single real photo.

mandalay.reason: Mostly trees and the moat's water surface, with Mandalay Palace only a tiny silhouette far in the background — does not meaningfully show the city.

mar-del-plata-ar.reason: A multi-panel collage/montage of 9 separate images, not a single real photo.

maracaibo-ve.reason: Real elevated photo of Maracaibo showing a dense arrangement of high-rise apartment buildings and streets — clear city view.

marseille-fr.reason: Real panoramic photo of Marseille from Notre-Dame de la Garde showing the harbor, old port, and full cityscape — excellent city view.

marano-di-napoli.reason: Real dusk photo showing the illuminated town/city spread below hills — a genuine, if atmospheric, city view.

maracay-ve.reason: Real photo of Maracay's skyline seen across a park/forest foreground — clear city view.
